{
"cycle": "rerun-2",
"assessment": "The current implementation covers the previously completed coherence/design-order items: DeckDesignOrderTrace builds the eight-stage chain, source evidence can come from structural chart evidence or a source-ledger bridge, stage-ref checks are present, and tests cover canonical order plus boundary-safe output.   Remaining local gaps are integration/validator gaps, not new design-order concepts.",
"locally_actionable_todos": [
{
"title": "Validate deck trace entries as an ordered artifact sequence",
"why": "validateReviewArtifactDesignOrder currently collects direct designOrder plus nested intents[].designOrder and recipes[].designOrder, but not entries[].stage from mdpr-deck-design-order-trace-v1 artifacts. That means a malformed trace-like artifact with scrambled entries can avoid DESIGN_ORDER_OUT_OF_SEQUENCE even though docs say generated review artifacts should be checked for out-of-order design stages.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md",
"06_IR_CONTRACTS.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"collectDesignOrders or validateReviewArtifactDesignOrder derives deck order from entries[].stage when entries contain known DeckDesignOrderStage values.",
"A trace artifact with entries ordered as semantic_visual_guidance before source_evidence emits DESIGN_ORDER_OUT_OF_SEQUENCE.",
"A canonical buildDeckDesignOrderTrace output still validates with no order finding.",
"Tests confirm findings remain evidence-only and contain no raw colors, coordinates, fixed geometry, renderer object ids, or final validation verdicts."
]
},
{
"title": "Expose an integrated coherence review path for chart placements",
"why": "reviewCoherence currently emits base coherence findings, selection grouping, evidence-claim alignment, semantic motif drift, and section rhythm, while reviewChartNarrativeFit is a separate call. Callers using only reviewCoherence can miss chart placement, narrative-fit, and claim-support warnings even though those checks now exist.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"Add optional chartPlacements to ReviewCoreInput and append reviewChartNarrativeFit findings when present, or expose a documented reviewDeckCoherence wrapper that composes both paths.",
"Existing reviewCoherence behavior is unchanged when chartPlacements are absent.",
"Integrated path emits chart placement slide/block/type/intent, narrative-fit, and claim-support findings as applicable.",
"No duplicate findings are produced by the integrated path, and tests use only semantic slide ids, block ids, and chart intents."
]
}
],
"external_or_manual_todos": [],
"duplicates_or_rejected": [
"Rejected as duplicate: DeckDesignOrderTrace and validateReviewArtifactDesignOrder.",
"Rejected as duplicate: structured chart visual guidance fields, narrativeFit, evidence-claim alignment, semantic motif drift, source evidence backfill, nested intent/recipe validation, stage-ref namespace validation, compatible-ref stage presence, chart placement checks, and source-ledger bridge.",
"Rejected as non-local: final MDPR parsing, rendering, layout, theme resolution, PPTX geometry, renderer object decisions, and pass/fail validation.",
"Rejected as boundary violation: raw workbook values, raw colors, fixed coordinates, renderer object ids, credentials, external uploads, and manual visual inspection."
]
}
